latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of “承运商指数查询” skill for querying logistics index data.

- Supports querying logistics indices filtered by carrier name, statistical date, and region (defaults provided for each).
- Provides industry averages, carrier rankings, and comparisons to industry mean.
- Displays trend chart for the specified index over the previous 7 days, highlighting fluctuations and differences.
- Data sources: http://jingwe.jdl.com/#/indexCenter/indexOverview and shipperOverview pages.
